text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—Alright, it should be fine to move on
to the next phase of gym training."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's increase the workload starting next week.
Yeah, let's ramp up the training load starting next week.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you.
Having decided on a policy of training throughout the Junior Class, Duramente practiced daily according to the roadmap she had created.
"Set specific parameters for each workout and gradually increase the load. That way, you can feel your daily progress."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Even time-wise,
she's putting up top-tier records for the Junior Year.
choice_data_list: Just a little more, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
――You're quite dedicated,
even until Lunchtime.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I thought perhaps we could have some tea together...
but would that be intruding?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No, we just finished talking.
I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Well, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I left the mail addressed to Duramente-san
on the desk, okay?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see, thank you.

An Umamusume who shares a dorm room with Duramente
and made her debut in the same generation.

A young lady of the Satono Group, which has rapidly risen in the racing world.
Coming from such an elite pedigree, she naturally commands the public's attention.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
That look in your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Wary. Isn't that a rather harsh glare
to give someone sharing lunch with you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer,
I simply gave the proper reaction."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you're the most
highly rated in our generation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hearing that from you, Duramente-san, is truly an honor.
In fact, Satono Crown has already produced results in graded stakes races, and has announced her run on the Classic Triple Crown path—starting with the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: So, what's your business?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Tea is just an excuse.
You value efficiency above all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh, Duramente-san.
I actually love chatting, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're barely in the room, so
you probably wouldn't know!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"But you know... I certainly love it when people are quick on the uptake♪
—To put it bluntly, I'm scoping out the competition."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to know your current condition—
since we are sure to clash in the all-important Classic races next year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling, Duramente?
How's your condition?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You think I'm gonna tell you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because,
you don't mind if they prepare counter-strategies against you, do you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ――Because I am "the strongest," after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...
Unfortunately, no.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's the strongest
because it can't be countered.

Quiet sparks are flying, hard to believe it's
just a peaceful corner of the cafeteria...
Both of them seem intensely aware of each other.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding!
I'm not going to get any useful data in a place like this."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—I am reflected in your eyes.
Now that I've confirmed that, I'm satisfied♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well then, thanks for having me. Make sure
you don't stay up too late tonight, okay!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Same to you.

The flow of her speech, her tone, her choice of words...
Everything conveys her keen intelligence.
And... her serious fighting spirit, as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Your caution is justified.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Crown is strong—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
See you after school, then.
Let's try out the menu we just finalized.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, wait, wait,
Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just a little bit more!
Let's practice for the Winning Live, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The center choreography!
It looks like you've almost got it down, right?
The energetic festival girl, Kitasan Black. The highly skilled middle sister of three, Cheval Grand. Both are Umamusume of the same generation as Duramente.

Both of them are very promising Umamusume,
and I've heard Kitasan Black is aiming
for the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine...
Just the backup dancer choreography is plenty...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Someday, you'll win and stand at center stage for sure!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We've only just begun!
There's no telling what's gonna happen!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...That might... be true, but...
Still...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The festival starts right here!
Let's dream big and have a blast, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's keep going!
No need to practice in secret—let's dance proudly out in the open!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Y-Y-Y-You were watching...!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...So many are aiming
for that single pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Without tiring, without slacking...
I must continue to strive.
During after-school training that day—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ghaaaaarrrrgh!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hyah...
Duramente-san, such incredible drive...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Her aura was already amazing, but... has it evolved? Whoa...—"

The Umamusume who were training couldn't help
stopping in their tracks to watch Duramente run.
Her running was truly "overwhelming"—
